name: First to Floor
tagline: Guess what falls first. A friendly physics-puzzle for kids 4+.
description: First to Floor is a friendly guess-the-order game for little kids — ages 4 and up. Colorful items rain down: a feather, an apple, a hammer, a pumpkin, a dinosaur. Watch the slow-motion preview, then guess the order they'll hit the floor. Real physics — feathers float, anvils drop. No penalties, no stress, no loud noises.

features.title: 10 themed worlds
features.description: Animals, fruits, vegetables, household, sport, tools, sweets, farm, dinosaurs and construction — each with its own falling cast.

features.title: Three difficulty levels
features.description: Easy, medium and hard rows that grow with the child — same worlds, more items, faster gravity.

features.title: Picture collection
features.description: Every correctly-guessed item joins your pokedex-style collection — come back any time and admire what you've gathered.

features.title: Two skills
features.description: Freeze time or ask for a hint when the items are flying fast — a gentle safety net, not a paywall.

features.title: Game Center built in
features.description: 16 achievements and a family high-score leaderboard, opt-in via the platform's system prompts.

features.title: Ad-free, kid-safe
features.description: No ads, no logins, no chat, no interruptive purchases. One parental gate unlocks all premium worlds forever.
